# dsh-cap-manager

**One panel for MCP servers, skills & Claude Code plugins in the
DeepSeek Harness Web UI.**
English | 简体中文

A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that adds an
**MCP & Skills** panel to the Web UI sidebar:

- **🔌 MCP servers** — cards grouped by scope (**global / profile / project**) with live
connection s

tatus and tool counts. Add, edit, toggle, and delete with immediate effect;
import `mcpServers` JSON

from Claude / Cursor / Cline / Roo / VS Code; export back.
- **🧠 Skills** — every writable skill ro

ot (project + user) in one searchable list. Edit
in place, import `.zip` archives or URLs, one-click

export, trash with restore, and
`.cap-bak` backup history.
- **🧩 Claude Code plugins** — browse Ant

hropic's official `claude-plugins-official`
marketplace (315+ plugins) inside dsh: install, update,

uninstall, and toggle. Plugin
skills light up through a native skill provider; plugin `mcpServers` m

ount as live
MCP connections.

Full design & compatibility notes: DESIGN.md. Current release: **v1.2.0**
(MCP servers mounted by Cl
aude Code plugins join the MCP tab as read-only rows).
## 🖼️ Screenshots

The panel appears in the sidebar as **MCP & Skills**. Below: the MCP tab showing all three
scopes —

project servers, global servers, and profile servers, each card with live status,
tool count, and an
enable switch (a disabled row keeps its config but does not mount).

Skills tab — project / global groups plus a read-only plugin-provided group
Plugins tab — installed
cards + the official market (315+)
Dark mode follows the host theme automatically

## 🔌 MCP servers
Each project may carry a `.dsh/mcp.yml` (hand-edited or managed from the panel):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- The file is the only source of truth: while the project has a live session (or is selected
in the

panel's project picker), its enabled servers are mounted; external edits are picked
up live (watcher

+ diff mount).
- `serverName` must stay unique across **all** layers — conflicts are rejected befor

e mount.
- **URL import** (⇩): fetch an `mcpServers` JSON document or a skill `.zip` directly by URL

.
The browser does the fetching, so the target must send CORS headers (GitHub raw and most
static ho

sts do); the payload then flows through the exact same preview / unpack pipeline
as pasted text or l

ocal files.
- The add form ships a template dropdown (filesystem, memory, sequential-thinking, fetch

,
github, puppeteer) for one-click starter configs.
## 🔁 Import / export

- **Import** (MCP tab → ⇩): paste, upload, or fetch an `mcpServers` JSON document — VS Code's
JSONC

dialect (comments, trailing commas) is tolerated, `sse` entries map to
`streamable-http` with a warn

ing, invalid keys are auto-slugged and flagged. `${VAR}` /
`${env:VAR}` references become `!!js proc

ess.env.VAR` expressions (backtick templates when
embedded); VS Code `${input:…}` placeholders rende

r a credential form whose values are
substituted at apply time. Preview lists every conversion, rena

me, and failure; applying
reuses the normal write path (shared validation, HMR live effect).
- **Exp

ort** (MCP tab → ⇧): merges every managed row plus the selected project's file into a
standard `{"mc

pServers": …}` document; `!!js` expressions fold back to `${VAR}`. Disabled
rows are skipped (the fo

rmat has no disabled flag). Secrets are exported in clear text —
the UI says so.
- **Skills import**

(Skills tab → ⇩): a `.zip` archive (an extra wrapper directory is fine —
skill roots are discovered

by `SKILL.md` location), a folder, loose `.md` files, or a zip
URL; archives up to 10 MB / 200 file

s, zip-slip paths rejected, macOS junk dropped. Files
land verbatim; same-name skills are skipped un

less overwrite is checked.
- **Skill export** (⇧ on a card): directory skills download as `.zip` (as

sets included),
file skills as `.md`.
- **Trash & backups** (♻): deleted skills list with their orig

inal path and restore
one-click; every `.cap-bak-*` copy beside the managed files (patches, project

`mcp.yml`,
SKILL.md — 5 kept per file) can be restored over its target or deleted.
## 🧠 Skills

The Skills tab scans the four writable roots (`<project>/.dsh/skills`,
`<project>/.agents/skills`, `

~/.dsh/skills`, `~/.agents/skills`) with the provider's own
rules and resolves same-name duplicates

by its rank order (project wins over user);
shadowed entries and unparsable files surface with badge

s instead of vanishing. Edits write
SKILL.md atomically (unknown frontmatter keys and comments prese

rved, toggles normalized to
`true/false`); deletion moves the directory into `~/.dsh/cap-manager/tra

sh/` (with
`trash-meta.json` recording the origin) and warns when a shadowed twin surfaces.
## 🧩 Claude Code plugins

The panel's third tab manages Claude Code plugins from Anthropic's official
`claude-plugins-official
` marketplace — the only built-in source.
